frozen_candidate_root_contribution: The root contributes CUSTODIAL KEEPING: actively maintaining some entity in a preserved, unbreached, un-lost state — holding a charge intact against loss, violation, escape, lapse, or corruption. It is not mere observation and not mere warding-off; it is the vigilant retention/safekeeping of X so that X remains whole and secure under the keeper's responsibility.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: The root contributes CUSTODIAL KEEPING: actively maintaining some entity in a preserved, unbreached, un-lost state — holding a charge intact against loss, violation, escape, lapse, or corruption. It is not mere observation and not mere warding-off; it is the vigilant retention/safekeeping of X so that X remains whole and secure under the keeper's responsibility.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Every occurrence, across all five form-families, resolves to "keep X intact / hold X in safe custody." (1) DIVINE PRESERVATION: God is HafiyZ "over all things" (11:57, 34:21, 42:6) — the ultimate custodian; His guarding (HifZ) of the heavens and earth does not tire Him (2:255); He guards the Reminder so it is not lost (15:9); He guarded the heaven from every devil (15:17), a guarding against every rebellious devil (37:7, 41:12), making the sky a "guarded roof" mahfuwZ (21:32). (2) ANGELIC CUSTODY: He sends "keepers" HafaZah over you (6:61); guardians who keep the person yaHfaZuwnahu (13:11); "guardians over you" laHAfiZiyn (82:10); "over every soul is a keeper" HAfiZ (86:4) — custodian-recorders, not idle watchers. (3) HUMAN GUARDIANSHIP: Jacob's sons pledge "we are indeed his keepers" laHAfiZuwn (12:12, 12:63) and "we will keep our brother" naHfaZu (12:65); "God is the best keeper" HAfiZan (12:64); Joseph offers himself as a "keeper, knowing" HafiyZ (12:55) over the storehouses. (4) NEGATED CUSTODY: the Prophet is repeatedly denied the role of custodian/overseer — "we did not send you over them as a keeper" HafiyZan (42:48, 6:107, 4:80), "you have no keeper's charge over them" (83:33), "I am no keeper over you" biHafiyZ (11:86, 6:104) — the residue (custody) is present and simply negated. (5) CHASTITY: those who "keep/guard their private parts" (23:5, 24:30, 24:31, 33:35, 70:29) — holding them inviolate. (6) MAINTAINING PRAYER (form III): "keep up / are assiduous over their prayers" yuHAfiZuwn (23:9, 6:92, 70:34), "keep guard over the prayers" HAfiZuw (2:238) — preserving the observance from lapse. (7) OATHS/LIMITS/COVENANT: "keep your oaths" iHfaZuw (5:89); "keepers of God's limits" al-HAfiZuwn li-Huduwd (9:112); the penitent "keeper" HafiyZ (50:32) — holding a commitment intact. (8) THE ABSENT/UNSEEN: righteous women "guarding the unseen/absent" HAfiZAt lil-ghayb (4:34) "by what God has kept" bimA HafiZa (4:34); "we were not keepers of the unseen" HAfiZiyn (12:81) — safekeeping what is out of sight. (9) PRESERVED RECORD: "a preserving book" kitAb HafiyZ (50:4); "a guarded Tablet" lawH mahfuwZ (85:22) — a record kept intact. (10) ENTRUSTED KEEPING (form X): rabbis/scholars "were made keepers of / entrusted with the Book of God" istuHfiZuw (5:44) — commissioned to hold it in custody. In every case the object is held whole and secure.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Subtracting the layers isolates a constant residue. FORM: I (HafiZa/yaHfaZu, iHfaZuw) = perform the act of keeping; participle (HAfiZ/HAfiZuwn/HAfiZAt) = the one holding custody; agent-noun HafaZah = a body of keepers; verbal noun HifZ/HifZan = the act/instance of keeping; intensive adj HafiyZ = a thorough/constant keeper; passive participle mahfuwZ = the thing kept; III (HAfaZa/yuHAfiZu) adds durative/assiduous engagement (keeping-up, persistence) over its object; X (istuHfiZa) adds the causative-requestive "be made/entrusted to keep." CONSTRUCTION: 'alā marks the domain or charge watched over ('alā kulli shay', 'alā ṣalawātihim, 'alaykum); li- marks the object entrusted to custody (li-furuwjihim, li-Huduwd, li-l-ghayb); bi- in bi-HafiyZ / bimA HafiZa frames the custodial relation; direct accusative names the guarded object (furuwjahum, aymānakum, akhānā). PARTICIPANTS (God, angels, prophets, Jacob's sons, believers, scholars) and CONTEXT (cosmological, eschatological-record, legal-ritual, narrative) vary freely. After removing all of these, what remains identically in all 44 is: holding an entity intact in safe custody so it is not lost, breached, or corrupted.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: The form-III "maintain/keep up the prayers" cluster (23:9, 6:92, 70:34, 2:238) is hardest, because here HfZ governs a repeated action, not a possessable object, and reads as "be assiduous/constant." But the residue survives cleanly: to keep up the prayers is to preserve the observance from lapse or loss — the object is held intact over time. The durative/persistent nuance is entirely supplied by Form III's morphology (mufā'ala) plus the 'alā frame, not by the root; strip those and the bare act "keep prayer (from lapsing)" remains custodial keeping. A close second is 4:34:20:1 "bimA HafiZa (A)llāh" ("because of / with what God has kept"), which is elliptical, but its immediate pairing with HAfiZAt lil-ghayb fixes it in the same custody/safekeeping field.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: The strongest alternative is "to watch over / observe attentively" (surveillance/vigilance), which fits the angel-recorder verses (82:10, 86:4, 6:61, 13:11) and God "over all things HafiyZ" very naturally. Internal evidence arbitrates against it: several occurrences involve no observation at all but pure retention — the "guarded Tablet" mahfuwZ (85:22) and the "preserving Book" kitAb HafiyZ (50:4) are kept intact, not watched; "keep your oaths" (5:89) and "keepers of God's limits" (9:112) concern maintaining a commitment, not observing it; "we guarded the heaven from every devil" (15:17) is exclusion/protection, not mere watching. Observation is at most instrumental to the custodial function (a keeper may watch in order to keep). Hence "keep intact / hold in custody" subsumes "watch over," but not vice versa, so the custodial reading is preferred.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Nearest neighbors: (a) r-q-b (raqīb) = observe/surveil/keep-an-eye — pure monitoring without the entailment of preserving the object's integrity; HfZ entails the object being held whole (the Tablet is mahfuwZ, not "raqīb-ed"). (b) w-q-y (wiqāya/taqwā) = shield/protect FROM a specific harm — a defensive vector against a threat; HfZ is broader and object-centered (retention/safekeeping), applying even where no external threat is named (keeping oaths, keeping prayers, a retaining Book). (c) H-w-ṭ (iHāṭa) = encompass/encircle (often of knowledge) — spatial/epistemic surrounding, not custody. Falsifiability condition: the custodial-keeping hypothesis would be falsified if a confirmed occurrence required HfZ to mean bare perception/observation with NO sense of retaining, protecting, or maintaining the object intact, or a sense wholly outside preservation (e.g., "create," "destroy," "count"). No such occurrence exists in the 44.
internal_discovery.rationale: A single non-empty contribution — custodial keeping (holding an entity intact in safe custody against loss/breach/lapse/corruption) — is surface-recoverable in all 44 occurrences with a determinate direction. The core reads directly in the participle/adjective forms (HAfiZ, HafiyZ, mahfuwZ = keeper/kept), in Form I (guard the private parts, guard the oaths, guard the brother, guard the heaven), in Form III once its durative morphology and 'alā-frame are subtracted (keep up = preserve-from-lapse), and in Form X as the requestive causative (be entrusted to keep). The negated prophet-verses carry the residue overtly and merely deny its application. The chief rival ("watch over/observe") is defeated by internal cases where nothing is observed but something is retained (the guarded Tablet, the retaining Book, kept oaths, kept limits), so the custodial sense properly subsumes the observational one. Neighboring roots (rqb observe, wqy shield-from-harm, HwT encompass) are sharply distinguished. No occurrence resists reconciliation by ordinary layer-subtraction; therefore clean universal presence holds and the disposition is PREFERRED with STRONG strength.

adversarial_verification.notes:
Refutation attempt across all 44 occurrences (6 ADJ, 26 N, 7 V, 4 V-III, 1 V-X) found no genuine failing occurrence; every token resolves to CUSTODIAL KEEPING (holding X intact/in safe custody against loss, breach, escape, lapse, or corruption).

Hardest cases and their resolution:
(1) Recorder-angel cluster (82:10 laHAfiZiyn, 86:4 HAfiZ, 6:61 HafaZah). This is the thinnest margin: 82:10-12 immediately glosses the keepers as "kirAman kAtibIn, yaʿlamUna mA tafʿalUn" (knowing scribes), which invites a pure surveillance/knowing reading that WOULD refute the candidate ("not mere observation"). It survives because the lexeme denotes keepers of the deed-RECORD (cf. kitAb HafiyZ 50:4), and 13:11 (yaHfaZUnahu min amri llAh) fixes the person-custody sense — the residue is keeping-a-charge/record intact, not idle watching. Real but non-fatal tension.
(2) Warding-off heaven (15:17, 37:7, 41:12, 21:32 mahfUZ). Candidate disclaims "mere warding-off," yet these verses foreground repelling devils. Resolved: the object (the heaven) is held inviolate/unbreached; "from every devil" names the threat and warding is the means, while keeping-integrity is the sense — distinct from a pure-repel root.
(3) Restraining the jinn (21:82): fits the candidate's explicit "against escape" clause.
(4) Form-III prayer cluster (2:238, 6:92, 23:9, 70:34): mufAʿala diligence nuance still reduces to keeping the observance un-lapsed.

Neighbor-root contrast: the contribution discriminates cleanly against rqb (watch/monitor), naZar/baSar (observe), dfʿ/dr' (repel), and ʿlm (know) — HfZ consistently adds the retention/keeping-intact-under-responsibility element the neighbors lack. The negated-custody cluster (11:86, 6:104, 42:48, 4:80, 6:107, 83:33) shows the residue is a discrete custodial role that can be denied, confirming it is not a vague blob. Falsifiable: a pure-observation or pure-knowledge or pure-repulsion occurrence would break it; none exists. No semantic split or homonymy detected. All 44 word_refs accounted for.
